dialogue.text: The first morning of the new school term -- and Aoi is already running late.
No, no, no -- not on the very first day!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: Her alarm had rung on time.
What failed was everything after it: the hem of her cardigan had snagged on her desk drawer, yanking open the emergency sewing kit her mother left out last night.
Aoi had spent seven full minutes trying to free herself from a trailing rainbow of thread.
I was defeated by... basic clothing maintenance.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral

dialogue.text: She lunged for the front door, jammed one foot into her loafer, and reached for the handle.
The handle came off in her hand.
...Why?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: She stared at the brass knob. The brass knob stared back, spiritually.
Okay. Window, then.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: neutral

dialogue.text: Two minutes later she was in the alley, skirt dusty, schoolbag crooked, dignity negotiable.
She broke into a run toward the corner bakery.
At that exact second, the bakery's sandwich board tipped forward.
Aoi swerved, clipped the edge with her bag, and sent a tray of freshly fried croquettes skidding off the outdoor rack like golden hockey pucks.
Whoa, whoa, whoa! My croquettes!
dialogue.speaker: Bakery Owner

dialogue.text: I-I'm so sorry!
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: She dropped to her knees to help. One croquette bounced off the curb, another rolled under a bicycle, and a third landed neatly in the hood of her uniform.
Ah— hot! Hot—
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: Don't move! You've got one in your collar!
dialogue.speaker: Bakery Owner

dialogue.text: He plucked it out with tongs. For one blessed second, it was so ridiculous that Aoi almost laughed.
Thank you... and I'm really sorry.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: Forget it. First day, right? Here. Take one that survived.
dialogue.speaker: Bakery Owner

dialogue.text: He pressed a paper-wrapped croquette into her hand.
I don't deserve a reward for this.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: sadness

dialogue.text: Still, the warm packet in her palm felt like a tiny miracle. She bowed and ran again.
Relief lasted exactly twelve seconds.
Her shoelace, tied in haste, whipped loose. She stepped on it, pitched forward, windmilled once, and the croquette launched from her hand in a perfect arc.
It landed on the road just as a passing bicycle rolled over it with quiet finality.
She stopped in the middle of the sidewalk, shoulders trembling.
It was trying so hard.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: sadness

dialogue.text: That was the low point. Not the lateness. Not the door handle. The flattened croquette, shining faintly in the morning sun.
A laugh escaped her anyway—small, helpless, almost disbelieving.
If even breakfast gave up... maybe I can stop panicking for one second.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: She crouched, retied both laces carefully, then checked her bag.
Inside was the attendance envelope she nearly forgot entirely.
Oh. Right. That would have been worse.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: At the final crosswalk before school, the light flashed red.
No running across!
dialogue.speaker: Crossing Guard

dialogue.text: Y-Yes, sorry.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear

dialogue.text: She bounced in place, breathing hard, watching the school gate across the street like it might drift away.
Then the guard looked at her dust-streaked uniform, the thread still hanging from her sleeve, and the dead seriousness on her face.
First day?
dialogue.speaker: Crossing Guard

dialogue.text: Does it show that much?
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: surprise

dialogue.text: Only from here to next week.
dialogue.speaker: Crossing Guard

dialogue.text: The light changed. She sprinted through the gate just as the opening bell began to ring.
Made it... somehow.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: happiness

dialogue.text: Bent over, cheeks pink, she touched the attendance envelope in her bag and let out one soft breath.
Please let the disasters stay outside the school today.
dialogue.speaker: Aoi
dialogue.label: fear
